title: Kubernetes cluster
description: Node, pod and container resources (kubelet), object state (k8s_cluster), Kubernetes events and error logs.

panels.title: Nodes ready
panels.description: Nodes whose Ready condition is True (k8s_cluster).

panels.title: Node CPU used
panels.description: Actual CPU usage (kubelet) over allocatable CPU.

panels.title: Node memory used
panels.description: Working set (what the OOM killer looks at) over allocatable memory.

panels.title: Node disk used
panels.description: Node root filesystem (images, logs, emptyDirs, local-path volumes).

panels.title: CPU requested
panels.description: Sum of container CPU requests over allocatable: what the scheduler sees as reserved.

panels.title: Memory requested
panels.description: Sum of container memory requests over allocatable.

panels.title: Failed pods
panels.description: Pods in phase Failed or Unknown.

panels.title: Containers not ready
panels.description: Containers failing readiness, excluding completed (Succeeded) pods.

panels.title: Containers with restarts
panels.description: Containers whose restart count is above 0 (k8s_cluster).

panels.title: Warning events
panels.description: Kubernetes Warning events in the selected time range.

panels.title: Network by namespace
panels.description: Receive above zero, transmit below.

panels.title: Container memory / limit (OOM risk)
panels.description: Working set over the memory limit. At 100% the container is OOMKilled. Containers without a limit are not listed.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) / max by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_memory_limit_bytes{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} > 0))

panels.title: Container CPU / limit (throttling)
panels.description: CPU usage over the CPU limit. Near 100% the container is being throttled. Containers without a limit are not listed.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name) (container_cpu_usage{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) / max by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name) (k8s_container_cpu_limit{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"} > 0))

panels.title: Persistent volume usage
panels.description: PVC-backed volumes as reported by the kubelet. Provisioners that do not report capacity (e.g. k3s local-path) do not appear.

panels.title: Container waiting / terminated reasons
panels.description: CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, ImagePullBackOff, CreateContainerConfigError, Error, ...

targets.expr: max by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_container_name, k8s_container_status_reason) (k8s_container_status_reason{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace", k8s_container_status_reason!="Completed"} > 0)

panels.title: Container restarts (increase)
panels.description: Restarts in the previous 10 minutes, per container.

panels.title: Workloads below desired replicas
panels.description: Desired minus available/ready replicas, for Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, workload) (label_replace(sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_deployment_name) (k8s_deployment_desired{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) - sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_deployment_name) (k8s_deployment_available{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) > 0, "workload", "deployment/$1", "k8s_deployment_name", "(.*)")) or sum by (k8s_namespace_name, workload) (label_replace(sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_statefulset_name) (k8s_statefulset_desired_pods{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) - sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_statefulset_name) (k8s_statefulset_ready_pods{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) > 0, "workload", "statefulset/$1", "k8s_statefulset_name", "(.*)")) or sum by (k8s_namespace_name, workload) (label_replace(sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_daemonset_name) (k8s_daemonset_desired_scheduled_nodes{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) - sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_daemonset_name) (k8s_daemonset_ready_nodes{k8s_namespace_name=~"$namespace"}) > 0, "workload", "daemonset/$1", "k8s_daemonset_name", "(.*)"))

panels.title: Warning events by reason
panels.description: BackOff, Unhealthy, FailedScheduling, FailedMount, OOMKilling, Evicted, ...

panels.title: Kubernetes events
panels.description: All Kubernetes Events (Normal and Warning). Attributes: k8s.event.reason, k8s.object.kind/name, k8s.event.count.

panels.title: Error logs ($namespace)
panels.description: Error-level logs from every container (node agent) and every service (OTLP) in the selected namespaces.
